name: shared-margin
description: A Codex-native room for reading books and watching films together, one shared moment at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Read books and watch films together with GPT-5.6.
interface.longDescription: Shared Margin lets a human and GPT-5.6 move through a book or film linearly, pause at the same passage or scene, exchange anchored notes, and keep a durable trail of the moments that mattered.
defaultPrompt: Open a book and read it with me one passage at a time.
Watch a film with me and pause when something catches you.
Show me the shared moments we have collected.
